newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan test-fires two military missiles.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan test-fires two military missiles.

text.p: Pakistan successfully test-fired a locally produced surface-to-air missile and an anti-tank guided missile on Wednesday, a military statement said.
The statement by the Inter-Services Public Relations directorate did not give the ranges of the surface-to-air Anza and the anti-tank Baktar Shikan missiles.
Pakistan announced in 1989 that it had produced its first shoulder-fired Anza missile with a range of up to five km (three miles).
It was not immediately known whether the missile fired on Wednesday was an improved version of one produced in 1989.

The military statement said the missile testing, held at firing ranges near the northwestern garrison town of Nowshera, was witnessed by Chief of the Army Staff General Jehangir Karamat, Pakistan's top nuclear scientist Abdul Qadeer Khan, other senior military officers and scientists.
